envelope.heading: DCAT Catalog
envelope.description: A DCAT-AP 3 catalog (JSON-LD) of the Assets in a collection or folder (or of the assets matching a search), read as you. Give `scope`: the collection's qualifiedName or GUID, or `search_string`. DigitalProducts and Agreements are Bitol's and are named in the notes, not exported; validated against the vendored DCAT-AP 3.0.1 SHACL shapes. Run with output_format DOCUMENT.

envelope.heading: DCAT Catalog (Turtle)
envelope.description: The DCAT Catalog document as Turtle: a DCAT-AP 3 catalog of the Assets in a collection or folder (or of the assets matching a search), read as you. Give `scope` or `search_string`. Run with output_format DOCUMENT.
